ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary share while the NYSE price is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x2 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price. This also halves the engine's naive market-cap estimate (ordinary shares x ADS price). Ratio stated in the filer's own FY2025 Form 20-F cover page (accession 0001628280-26-021178): each ADS represents 2 ordinary shares.
ads_ratio.source: Prudential plc Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (accession 0001628280-26-021178, filed 2026-03-26), cover page: Title of 12(b) Security 'American Depositary Shares, each representing 2 Ordinary Shares, 5 pence par value each', trading symbol PUK, New York Stock Exchange (the ordinary shares themselves are registered separately as PUK/D, not traded as the priced security). Earlier citation (2026-10-14 worker): Prudential plc Form 20-F cover / registered security title for the NYSE listing: American Depositary Shares, each representing two ordinary shares of 5 pence each (EDGAR security title 'PRUDENTIAL PLC ADS (REP 2 ORD SHARES)'); the same 1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares ratio is stated in the filer's Form S-8/F-6 registrations

sbc_override.source: Prudential plc Annual Report 2024 (financial statements incorporated in Form 20-F for FY2024), note B2.2(d) 'Sharebased payment expense charged to the income statement': total expense recognised in 2024 relating to sharebased compensation is $85 million (2023: $81 million), of which $76 million equity-settled. Prudential reports in US dollars.
sbc_override.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc - SBC missing for FY2020-25 under every ifrs-full tag the engine reads (ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees was last filed for FY2019, $181M USD). The filer's own stated FY2024 expense fills the gap in principle; the engine applies a single value to every missing period and FY2023's value in the same note ($81M) is the same magnitude (~2-3% of OCF). NOTE (2026-10-14 worker): the engine did NOT apply this override - _override_usd requires a GBP ECB rate for each fill period because stray GBP facts through 2018 created fx_info, and rates_by_currency[GBP] covers only 2014-2018, so fills for 2020-25 return None and the gap stands. Engine/main-agent fix needed; see queue block reason. ENGINE 5.5 RE-SCORE (2026-10-19): the 2026-10-14 note above is superseded. Ruling 7: currency "USD" is added (the note is presented in US$ millions), and engine 5.5 uses the value verbatim (override_checks.sbc.currency_basis declared_usd) for every missing year, FY2020-25, so DATA_GAP:sbc is covered. The value is carried through unchanged at $85M (WORKER_SPEC step 8: an override already in judgment.json is a main-agent decision). For the record, the FY2025 Form 20-F (accession 0001628280-26-021178, filed 2026-03-26), note B2.2(d), states $95M for 2025 (2024: $85M; 2023: $81M); whether to restate the single value to $95M is left to Andrew. Correction to the text above: SBC is not ~2-3% of OCF in every year; $85M is about 10% of FY2023 OCF ($832M), 2.4% of FY2024 ($3,609M) and 3.5% of FY2025 ($2,450M).
